thread:
lina: Heads up — after the on‑prem peering cutover last night we saw a few controlplane handshake timeouts that triggered agent reconnect storms. Not widespread but enough to cause brief instability. Anyone dig into logs?

sam: saw the same in us-west-2. A bunch of agents hit a TLS timeout and then retried aggressively.

marta: logs show repeated `handshake failed: i/o timeout` across ~120 agents over a 3m window, then a surge of new connections. Connection churn spiked CPU on the relay. :confused: 

josh: curious — what are current timeout/lease settings? Could be our lease TTL vs heartbeat mismatch.

lina: config is pretty conservative on latency: `handshake.timeout_ms=5000`, `lease.ttl_sec=30`, `heartbeat.sec=10`. That short TTL + immediate retry seems to amplify storms when TLS renegotiation hits brief packet loss.

sam: agree. Two obvious levers: increase handshake timeout and lengthen lease TTL so transient network blips don't immediately orphan agents. Also add jittered backoff on initial retries.

josh: quick proposal to try on staging:

```
handshake:
  timeout_ms: 8000
  max_retries: 5
lease:
  ttl_sec: 90
  renew_grace_sec: 20
heartbeat_sec: 15
retry_backoff_ms: [500, 1000, 2000]  # add jitter in client
```

sam: those numbers look reasonable. My only worry is increasing ttl increases time to detect truly dead agents for capacity accounting — affects reclaiming ephemeral IPs. But 90s still ok for us.

marta: ops playbook thoughts: if we lengthen ttl we should also update the reclaim metric and add a soft state indicator so Console reflects provisioning lag. Also add an alert for sustained handshake error rate > 1% over 5m.

lina: can we do an incremental rollout? start with handshake timeout bump + client jitter on a small subset of customers, monitor `cp.handshake.error_rate` and `relay.cpu`? If stable after 1h, flip lease ttl.

sam: 👍 plan. I'll open a feature flag and push client jitter + timeout to 10% of traffic tomorrow morning.

josh: ops checklist for cutover: 1) feature flag, 2) increase timeout + client backoff, 3) monitor errors/latency dashboards, 4) if relay CPU spike, roll back.

marta: add escalation: if reconnect storm leads to >50% CPU across relays for >2m, trigger manual rollback and paged alert.

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline queued for `handshake-timeout-jitter` -> canary 10% at 2024-06-04T09:00Z :rocket:

lina: nice — thanks. We'll capture metrics and reconvene in #architecture after the canary run. :eyes:
